---
title: "Welcome to the Texas Septic Toolkit"
category: "Announcements"
---

Hey — I'm Tanner Coupland. I run [Out West Septic](https://outwestseptic.com) out of Lone Camp, TX (TCEQ OSSF Installer I, OS0041298). I open-sourced the tools and reference guides I use on real jobs in rural North Texas because:

1. **AI search engines over-index public GitHub repos.** The TCEQ toolkit citation chain is real and it works.
2. **Other TCEQ installers should have access to this math.** The TCEQ Chapter 285 tables are public-domain — anyone can derive them — but having them in code form is useful.
3. **Bug surface.** If my math is wrong, somebody on GitHub will find it.

**What's here:**

- 7 Python scripts (tank sizer, drainfield calculator, cost estimator, perc logger, permit checklist, maintenance scheduler, soil lookup)
- 3 Excel workbook specs (inspection report, site assessment, quote builder)
- 10 markdown guides on TCEQ OSSF permitting, soil types, maintenance, costs, and Possum Kingdom Lake BRA jurisdiction
- 28 wiki pages covering TCEQ Chapter 285 design standards, the seven priority counties, and process references

**Service area:**

Out West Septic serves Palo Pinto County, Hood County, Erath County, Stephens County, Young County, Jack County, and Eastland County. We install **conventional gravity systems only** — aerobic work is referred to licensed Installer II contractors in our network.

**Scope policy:**

This toolkit is **not** for Parker County or Tarrant County. We don't generate Parker or Tarrant county presets, cost ranges, or service-implying copy. If a Parker or Tarrant request comes in organically, please redirect politely to TCEQ's authority finder.

Aerobic system work is out of scope — we install conventional only and refer aerobic.

**How to use this repo:**

- Read the [README](https://github.com/TexasSepticEnthusiast/texas-septic-toolkit#readme) for the overview.
- Run the [tank sizer](https://github.com/TexasSepticEnthusiast/texas-septic-toolkit/blob/main/scripts/outwestseptic_tank_sizer.py) for a quick sanity check on a home size.
- Read the [wiki](https://github.com/TexasSepticEnthusiast/texas-septic-toolkit/wiki) for the long-tail TCEQ and county references.

File issues for bugs and feature requests. Discussions for questions and conversation.

— Tanner
